Compute perplexity of a text file using a loaded model.

Run with: `cargo run --release --example perplexity -p inference-examples`

```rust
//! Compute perplexity of a text file using a loaded model.
//!
//! Run with: `cargo run --release --example perplexity -p inference-examples`

use std::{
    fs::{File, read_to_string},
    io::{BufReader, Read},
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
    time::Instant,
};

use anyhow::Context;
use anyhow::Result;
use clap::Parser;
use inference::{
    GgufModelBuilder, LogitsOutput, MemoryGpuConfig, Model, ModelBuilder,
    PagedAttentionMetaBuilder, PagedCacheType, PromptInput, PromptLogitsRequest,
    api::operations::TokenizeRequest,
};

// tokens past a scored window the cache is planned for
const WINDOW_HEADROOM: usize = 256;
const PROMPT_CHUNKSIZE: usize = 1024;
// llama-perplexity scores a window's second half, so a window needs a few tokens on each side
const MIN_LLAMA_CPP_CTX: usize = 4;
// llama-perplexity's `--kl-divergence-base` file opens with this, and skips base log-probs at or below the floor
const KLD_BASE_MAGIC: &[u8; 8] = b"_logits_";
const KLD_LOG_PROB_FLOOR: f32 = -16.0;
// a row's logprob of its next token, from our logits against the engine's own, agrees to this
const ROW_CHECK_TOLERANCE: f32 = 1e-3;

/// Calculate perplexity of a model. By default, this uses the Llama 3.1 8B model.
#[derive(Parser)]
struct Args {
    /// The model to run.
    #[arg(short, long, default_value = "google/gemma-4-E4B-it")]
    model_id: String,

    /// Filename to text to run the model on. This is recommended to be the Wikitext 2 dataset:
    /// https://huggingface.co/datasets/EricB/wikitext2
    #[arg(short, long)]
    file: String,

    /// ISQ quantization to run with (`4`, `q4k`, ...).
    #[arg(short, long)]
    isq: Option<String>,

    /// Generate and utilize an imatrix to enhance GGUF quantizations.
    #[arg(short, long)]
    calibration_file: Option<PathBuf>,

    /// Local GGUF files to score instead of `--model-id`: one file, or every shard of a split one.
    #[arg(long, num_args = 1..)]
    gguf: Vec<PathBuf>,

    /// MoE experts kept in host memory with this many per layer cached on the GPU.
    #[arg(long)]
    moe_expert_cache: Option<usize>,

    /// The paged KV cache's storage (`auto`, `f8e4m3`, `q4`, `q8/q4`, ...).
    #[arg(long)]
    pa_cache_type: Option<PagedCacheType>,

    /// Prefill prompts this many tokens a step (a request's own scoring pass still runs in one).
    #[arg(long)]
    prefill_chunk: Option<usize>,

    /// Score each chunk's first N tokens first, so the full chunk finds them in the prefix cache and its later tokens
    /// attend over the stored (possibly quantized) K/V, as decoding does; only the tokens past N are scored.
    #[arg(long)]
    cached_prefix: Option<usize>,

    /// Score like `llama-perplexity -c <N> --chunks 1`: the first N tokens, each in the second half given everything
    /// before it, printed as `PPL = <value>`.
    #[arg(long)]
    llama_cpp_ctx: Option<usize>,

    /// Score against a `llama-perplexity --kl-divergence-base` file: its chunks' tokens, each chunk's second half,
    /// printing our perplexity, the base's, the KL divergence from the base and how often the top token agrees.
    #[arg(long)]
    kld_base: Option<PathBuf>,
}

fn tokenize(text: String, add_special_tokens: bool) -> TokenizeRequest {
    TokenizeRequest {
        model: None,
        text,
        add_special_tokens,
    }
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    let args = Args::parse();

    let model = match args.gguf.first() {
        Some(first) => {
            let dir = first.parent().context("the GGUF path has no directory")?;
            let names = args
                .gguf
                .iter()
                .map(|gguf| {
                    gguf.file_name()
                        .map(|name| name.to_string_lossy().to_string())
                        .context("a GGUF path has no file name")
                })
                .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
            let mut builder = GgufModelBuilder::new(dir.to_string_lossy(), names).with_logging();
            if let Some(experts) = args.moe_expert_cache {
                builder = builder.with_moe_expert_cache(experts);
            }
            if let Some(cache_type) = args.pa_cache_type {
                let mut paged =
                    PagedAttentionMetaBuilder::default().with_paged_cache_type(cache_type);
                // the cache holds the scored window whole
                if let Some(ctx) = args.llama_cpp_ctx {
                    paged =
                        paged.with_gpu_memory(MemoryGpuConfig::ContextSize(ctx + WINDOW_HEADROOM));
                }
                builder = builder.with_paged_attn(paged.build()?);
            }
            builder.build().await?
        }
        None => {
            let mut model_builder = ModelBuilder::new(&args.model_id).with_logging();
            if let Some(isq) = &args.isq {
                let isq = inference::parse_isq_value(isq, None).map_err(anyhow::Error::msg)?;
                model_builder = model_builder.with_isq(isq);
            }
            if let Some(calibration_file) = &args.calibration_file {
                model_builder = model_builder.with_calibration_file(calibration_file.clone());
            }
            if let Some(cache_type) = args.pa_cache_type {
                model_builder = model_builder.with_paged_attn(
                    PagedAttentionMetaBuilder::default()
                        .with_paged_cache_type(cache_type)
                        .build()?,
                );
            }
            if let Some(tokens) = args.prefill_chunk {
                model_builder = model_builder.with_max_prefill_chunk_tokens(tokens);
            }
            model_builder.build().await?
        }
    };

    if let Some(base) = &args.kld_base {
        return kl_divergence(&model, base).await;
    }
    let text = read_to_string(&args.file)?;
    if let Some(ctx) = args.llama_cpp_ctx {
        let perplexity = llama_cpp_window(&model, text, ctx).await?;
        println!("PPL = {perplexity:.4}");
        return Ok(());
    }
    let tokens = model.tokenize(tokenize(text, false)).await?.tokens;
    let bos_token = model
        .tokenize(tokenize(" ".to_string(), true))
        .await?
        .tokens[0];

    println!("Using bos token id `{bos_token}`.");

    let n_chunks = tokens.len().div_ceil(PROMPT_CHUNKSIZE);
    let mut ppl_measurements = Vec::new();
    for (i, chunk) in tokens.chunks(PROMPT_CHUNKSIZE).enumerate() {
        let start = Instant::now();
        let request = PromptLogitsRequest {
            model: None,
            prompt: PromptInput::Tokens([vec![bos_token], chunk.to_vec()].concat()),
            output: LogitsOutput::Logprobs,
        };
        let prompt = [vec![bos_token], chunk.to_vec()].concat();
        let skip = match args.cached_prefix {
            Some(prefix) if prefix + 1 < prompt.len() => {
                let warm = PromptLogitsRequest {
                    model: None,
                    prompt: PromptInput::Tokens(prompt[..=prefix].to_vec()),
                    output: LogitsOutput::Logprobs,
                };
                model.prompt_logits(warm).await?;
                prefix + 1
            }
            _ => 0,
        };
        let scored = model.prompt_logits(request).await?;

        // The first token has no prediction; the rest give the mean negative log-likelihood.
        let logprobs: Vec<f32> = scored.token_logprobs[skip..]
            .iter()
            .flatten()
            .copied()
            .collect();
        let nll = -logprobs.iter().sum::<f32>() / logprobs.len() as f32;
        let perplexity = nll.exp();
        let end = Instant::now();

        ppl_measurements.push(perplexity);
        println!(
            "Chunk {i}/{n_chunks} ({} tokens): Perplexity for `{}`, ISQ `{:?}`, {}s: {perplexity}",
            scored.tokens.len(),
            args.file,
            args.isq,
            end.duration_since(start).as_secs_f32(),
        );
    }

    let mean = ppl_measurements.iter().sum::<f32>() / ppl_measurements.len() as f32;
    let variance = ppl_measurements
        .iter()
        .map(|e| (mean - e).powf(2.))
        .sum::<f32>()
        / ppl_measurements.len() as f32;
    let std_dev = variance.sqrt();
    println!();
    println!(
        "Final perplexity for `{}`, ISQ `{:?}`: {} +/- {} ppl",
        args.file, args.isq, mean, std_dev
    );

    Ok(())
}

async fn llama_cpp_window(model: &Model, text: String, ctx: usize) -> Result<f64> {
    anyhow::ensure!(
        ctx >= MIN_LLAMA_CPP_CTX,
        "--llama-cpp-ctx must be at least {MIN_LLAMA_CPP_CTX}"
    );
    let tokens = model.tokenize(tokenize(text, true)).await?.tokens;
    // llama-perplexity refuses texts shorter than two windows
    anyhow::ensure!(
        tokens.len() >= 2 * ctx,
        "the text is shorter than two windows"
    );
    let request = PromptLogitsRequest {
        model: None,
        prompt: PromptInput::Tokens(tokens[..ctx].to_vec()),
        output: LogitsOutput::Logprobs,
    };
    let scored = model.prompt_logits(request).await?;
    // index i holds token i's logprob given the tokens before it; the first has none
    let logprobs = scored.token_logprobs[ctx / 2 + 1..]
        .iter()
        .map(|logprob| {
            logprob
                .map(f64::from)
                .context("a scored token has no logprob")
        })
        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
    Ok((-logprobs.iter().sum::<f64>() / logprobs.len() as f64).exp())
}

fn read_i32(reader: &mut impl Read) -> Result<i32> {
    let mut bytes = [0u8; 4];
    reader.read_exact(&mut bytes)?;
    Ok(i32::from_le_bytes(bytes))
}

// KL(base || ours) over one position as llama-perplexity computes it, our and the base's logprob of the next token,
// and whether the two top tokens agree; `record` is the base's: its scale and floor as two f32, then a u16 per token
fn score_row(logits: &[f32], record: &[u8], next: usize) -> (f64, f64, f64, bool) {
    let (imax, max_logit) =
        logits
            .iter()
            .copied()
            .enumerate()
            .fold(
                (0, f32::NEG_INFINITY),
                |m, (i, v)| if v > m.1 { (i, v) } else { m },
            );
    let log_sum_exp = logits
        .iter()
        .map(|v| f64::from((v - max_logit).exp()))
        .sum::<f64>()
        .ln() as f32;
    let float = |at: usize| {
        f32::from_le_bytes([record[at], record[at + 1], record[at + 2], record[at + 3]])
    };
    let (scale, floor) = (float(0), float(4));
    let base = record[8..]
        .as_chunks::<2>()
        .0
        .iter()
        .map(|b| u16::from_le_bytes(*b))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let ours = |i: usize| logits[i] - max_logit - log_sum_exp;
    let mut kld = 0.0;
    let (mut imax_base, mut base_max) = (0, f32::NEG_INFINITY);
    for (i, &q) in base.iter().take(logits.len()).enumerate() {
        let p_log = scale * f32::from(q) + floor;
        if p_log > base_max {
            base_max = p_log;
            imax_base = i;
        }
        if p_log > KLD_LOG_PROB_FLOOR {
            kld += f64::from(p_log.exp() * (p_log - ours(i)));
        }
    }
    let base_logprob = scale * f32::from(base[next]) + floor;
    (
        kld,
        f64::from(ours(next)),
        f64::from(base_logprob),
        imax == imax_base,
    )
}

async fn kl_divergence(model: &Model, path: &Path) -> Result<()> {
    let mut reader = BufReader::new(File::open(path)?);
    let mut magic = [0u8; 8];
    reader.read_exact(&mut magic)?;
    anyhow::ensure!(
        &magic == KLD_BASE_MAGIC,
        "{} is not a llama-perplexity KL divergence base",
        path.display()
    );
    let n_ctx = usize::try_from(read_i32(&mut reader)?)?;
    let n_vocab = usize::try_from(read_i32(&mut reader)?)?;
    let n_chunk = usize::try_from(read_i32(&mut reader)?)?;
    let mut tokens = Vec::with_capacity(n_chunk * n_ctx);
    for _ in 0..n_chunk * n_ctx {
        tokens.push(u32::try_from(read_i32(&mut reader)?)?);
    }
    // llama-perplexity scores positions first..n_ctx - 1 of each chunk, each predicting the next token
    let first = n_ctx / 2;
    let record = 2 * n_vocab.div_ceil(2) + 4;
    let mut bytes = vec![0u8; record * 2];
    let (mut klds, mut nll, mut nll_base, mut same_top) = (Vec::new(), 0.0, 0.0, 0usize);
    for (c, chunk) in tokens.chunks(n_ctx).enumerate() {
        let start = Instant::now();
        let scored = model
            .prompt_logits(PromptLogitsRequest {
                model: None,
                prompt: PromptInput::Tokens(chunk.to_vec()),
                output: LogitsOutput::Logits,
            })
            .await?;
        let logits = scored.logits.context("the engine returned no logits")?;
        let vocab = scored.vocab_size;
        anyhow::ensure!(
            vocab <= n_vocab,
            "our vocab ({vocab}) is wider than the base's ({n_vocab})"
        );
        for row in first..n_ctx - 1 {
            reader.read_exact(&mut bytes)?;
            let next = chunk[row + 1] as usize;
            let (kld, logprob, base_logprob, same) =
                score_row(&logits[row * vocab..][..vocab], &bytes, next);
            if c == 0 && row == first {
                let engine =
                    scored.token_logprobs[row + 1].context("a scored token has no logprob")?;
                anyhow::ensure!(
                    (engine - logprob as f32).abs() < ROW_CHECK_TOLERANCE,
                    "logits row {row} does not predict token {}: {logprob} against the engine's {engine}",
                    row + 1
                );
            }
            klds.push(kld);
            nll -= logprob;
            nll_base -= base_logprob;
            same_top += usize::from(same);
        }
        let n = klds.len() as f64;
        println!(
            "chunk {}/{n_chunk}: PPL {:.4}, base {:.4}, mean KLD {:.5}, same top {:.2}% ({:.1}s)",
            c + 1,
            (nll / n).exp(),
            (nll_base / n).exp(),
            klds.iter().sum::<f64>() / n,
            100.0 * same_top as f64 / n,
            start.elapsed().as_secs_f32()
        );
    }
    let n = klds.len() as f64;
    let mean = klds.iter().sum::<f64>() / n;
    klds.sort_by(f64::total_cmp);
    let pick = |q: f64| klds[((klds.len() - 1) as f64 * q).round() as usize];
    println!();
    println!("{} positions over {n_chunk} chunks of {n_ctx}", klds.len());
    println!(
        "PPL            {:.4} (base {:.4})",
        (nll / n).exp(),
        (nll_base / n).exp()
    );
    println!("KLD mean       {mean:.5}");
    println!("KLD median     {:.5}", pick(0.5));
    println!("KLD p99        {:.5}", pick(0.99));
    println!("same top-1     {:.2}%", 100.0 * same_top as f64 / n);
    Ok(())
}
```
